# Getting help

Here is where to look when you need a hand with WAMBLE.

## Start with the docs

- The [README](../README.md) covers installation, the available tools, and
  common problems such as Bluetooth permissions.
- The [gatt_cli cheatsheet](../docs/GATT-CLI-CHEATSHEET.md) explains the
  interactive prompt and how the LED control payloads are built.
- The [exploits README](../src/wamble/exploits/README.md) documents the
  proof-of-concept tools.

## Still stuck

Open an issue in the issue tracker. A good question includes:

- what you were trying to do
- the exact command you ran
- what you expected and what happened instead
- your operating system and Python version

If it looks like a bug, use the bug report template. If a device behaves in a way
WAMBLE does not handle, the device report template is the right one.

## Security and responsible use

Please do not post anything that would help someone attack a device they do not
own. For reporting a security problem in WAMBLE itself, see
[SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## Response time

WAMBLE is maintained in spare time, so answers are best effort. You can usually
expect a first reply within about a week.
